(async () => {  const FROM = 'Template hours lower the margin of every fixed-price TYPO3 project.'; const TO = 'Template hours cut into the margin of every fixed-price TYPO3 project.'; const link = document.querySelector('a[href*="docx-editor/page/download"]'); const input = document.querySelector('[data-page-sync-upload]'); if (!link || !input) throw new Error('download link or upload field missing');  const nativeFetch = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = async (...args) => { const response = await nativeFetch(...args); if (String(args[0]).includes('/docx-editor/page/preview')) { response.clone().json().then((data) => { const url = window.TYPO3?.settings?.ajaxUrls?.docx_editor_page_discard; if (data && data.id && url) { nativeFetch(url, { method: 'POST', keepalive: true, credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest', Accept: 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ id: data.id }) }).catch(() => {}); } }).catch(() => {}); } return response; }; const download = await nativeFetch(link.href, { credentials: 'same-origin' }); const fileName = (/filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(download.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '') || [])[1] || 'page.docx'; const bytes = new Uint8Array(await download.arrayBuffer()); const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer); let end = bytes.length - 22; while (end >= 0 && view.getUint32(end, true) !== 0x06054b50) end -= 1; const count = view.getUint16(end + 10, true); let at = view.getUint32(end + 16, true); const entries = []; for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) { const nameLength = view.getUint16(at + 28, true); const local = view.getUint32(at + 42, true); const start = local + 30 + view.getUint16(local + 26, true) + view.getUint16(local + 28, true); entries.push({ name: bytes.subarray(at + 46, at + 46 + nameLength), method: view.getUint16(at + 10, true), time: view.getUint16(at + 12, true), date: view.getUint16(at + 14, true), crc: view.getUint32(at + 16, true), size: view.getUint32(at + 24, true), data: bytes.subarray(start, start + view.getUint32(at + 20, true)), }); at += 46 + nameLength + view.getUint16(at + 30, true) + view.getUint16(at + 32, true); } const doc = entries.find((entry) => new TextDecoder().decode(entry.name) === 'word/document.xml'); const raw = doc.method === 8 ? new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([doc.data]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw'))).arrayBuffer()) : doc.data; const xml = new TextDecoder().decode(raw); if (!xml.includes(FROM)) throw new Error('sentence not found'); const changed = new TextEncoder().encode(xml.replace(FROM, TO)); let crc = 0xffffffff; for (const byte of changed) { crc ^= byte; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k += 1) crc = crc & 1 ? (crc >>> 1) ^ 0xedb88320 : crc >>> 1; } Object.assign(doc, { method: 0, crc: (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0, size: changed.length, data: changed }); const parts = []; const central = []; let offset = 0; for (const entry of entries) { const head = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(30)); head.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true); head.setUint16(4, 20, true); head.setUint16(8, entry.method, true); head.setUint16(10, entry.time, true); head.setUint16(12, entry.date, true); head.setUint32(14, entry.crc, true); head.setUint32(18, entry.data.length, true); head.setUint32(22, entry.size, true); head.setUint16(26, entry.name.length, true); const dir = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(46)); dir.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true); dir.setUint16(4, 20, true); dir.setUint16(6, 20, true); dir.setUint16(10, entry.method, true); dir.setUint16(12, entry.time, true); dir.setUint16(14, entry.date, true); dir.setUint32(16, entry.crc, true); dir.setUint32(20, entry.data.length, true); dir.setUint32(24, entry.size, true); dir.setUint16(28, entry.name.length, true); dir.setUint32(42, offset, true); parts.push(new Uint8Array(head.buffer), entry.name, entry.data); central.push(new Uint8Array(dir.buffer), entry.name); offset += 30 + entry.name.length + entry.data.length; } const tail = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(22)); tail.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true); tail.setUint16(8, entries.length, true); tail.setUint16(10, entries.length, true); tail.setUint32(12, central.reduce((sum, part) => sum + part.length, 0), true); tail.setUint32(16, offset, true); const file = new File([...parts, ...central, new Uint8Array(tail.buffer)], fileName, { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' }); const transfer = new DataTransfer(); transfer.items.add(file); input.files = transfer.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()
